units: <cite ref="Megillah 15a:2">Meg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>כל</he> (<cite ref="M02395"><he>מקום</he></cite>) <he>ששמו … בנ׳ וכ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) wherever the name of a person and that of his father are mentioned in connection with prophecy, it is sure that he was a prophet and the son of a prophet.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:13">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מה זכה עובדיהו לנ׳</he> for what merit was Obadiah granted the gift of prophecy?—
<cite ref="Bekhorot 45a:11">Bekh. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>עשו דבריהם כדברי נ׳</he> they made their verdicts like those of prophecy, i.e. they gave no reasons for their opinions.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 12a:12">B. Bath. 12ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 60b:10">Erub. 60ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אלו אלא דברי נ׳</he> these are prophetic verdicts, i.e. obviously well-established traditions; a. e.
